name: Demo plant
description: A generic demonstration plant invented by DIMOS (no customer data): inbound conveyor line, 3 high-bay aisles of 74 columns x 12 levels x 2 sides (5,328 bins, the size of the INL high bay), stacker cranes, a 3-level hoist, 2 outbound stations, an AGV path, handling-unit types with nesting, demo user groups, workstation groups, workstations and parameter overrides.
